note: Wave 11 (2026-10-15). Grouping and directions by an agent from the claims' titles and evidence entries. The hub is general reading-strategy instruction on print texts, the parent of this page's topic; no claim in the wiki tests strategy instruction for online reading. Members are print-reading strategy-instruction studies (Üstündağ-Algın 2025; Yurttaş-Kumlu 2023), so the finding rests on four distinct studies including the hub's two meta-analyses.

findings.question: Does explicitly teaching reading strategies (modelled, practised and named) improve comprehension beyond reading practice alone, and how far does that hold in ordinary classrooms?
